title: Down the Mississippi on the steamboat to New Orleans
summary: Playing moonlight excursions at Memphis, Helena, Vicksburg and other towns with calliope and crowds, then arriving at New Orleans where rival boats saluted them.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Yeah.
But now we were getting a touch of the world. We were playing Memphis on this side.
And you'd never seen Memphis before.

And on the other side is Helena, Arkansas. I'll never forget it. It's just like today, you know. I remember it just like today. And then you'd go down a little further and you'd run into Vicksburg, Mississippi on one side, and you'd take the excursion. If you're coming in in the day, the calliope plays, you know (Singing).
Oh, yeah. Yeah.
You know, with the steam coming out?
Yeah.
That's to let everybody know you're there.
That's right. And then everybody comes down to the --
They come down and look, you know. Then they go back home for dinner and get dressed, and then they come on the boat, you know.
Yeah.
For the moonlight ride.
How much would they have to pay for those excursions, can you remember?
I don't know, now.
A couple dollars, I suppose, huh?
Maybe. Maybe a dollar and a half.
Yeah.
Something like that, you know.
Yeah.
Because they'd draw a crowd wherever they went.
Oh, yeah, sure they would.

Then you'd go down further, then you're in Louisiana and Mississippi. Then you get to New Orleans. A big thing, because all the other boats from St. Louis, like the Streckfuss company they'd all start to salute you when you're coming in. All kinds of whistles and things. Exciting, you know.
Well, how many boats would be in there like that?

Oh, it'd be about -- I imagine about four or five boats, you know, because Streckfuss had two or three, and I imagine there was a couple out of New Orleans, and you're coming into the Gulf now, you know.
